structured_requirements.title: Candidate registration
structured_requirements.description: Candidates must be able to register with email and password and verify ownership via an email confirmation link.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: New candidate completes registration in under 90 seconds; verification email sent within 30 seconds.

structured_requirements.title: Resume upload
structured_requirements.description: Candidates can upload a resume document (PDF or DOCX, up to 5 MB) during application submission.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: Upload accepted for PDF/DOCX up to 5MB; stored with checksum and metadata.

structured_requirements.title: Recruiter application dashboard
structured_requirements.description: Recruiters can view all submitted applications for their open roles, filter by role, and download resumes.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: Dashboard loads within 2 seconds for up to 500 applications; filter and download work end-to-end.

structured_requirements.title: AI-based role matching
structured_requirements.description: The platform must use machine learning to match candidate resumes to suitable open roles based on skills and experience. Match scores must be retrievable per candidate.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: Top-5 matched roles surfaced per candidate; match relevance precision > 70% on a labelled validation set.

structured_requirements.title: Audit logging of recruiter actions
structured_requirements.description: Every recruiter action (view, download, status change) on a candidate record must be persisted as an immutable audit event.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: 100% of recruiter mutating actions emit an audit event with actor, target, action, timestamp; events are append-only.

structured_requirements.title: GDPR data handling
structured_requirements.description: All candidate PII must be stored encrypted at rest, deletable on request within 30 days, and exportable on subject access request.
structured_requirements.acceptance_criterion: Erasure workflow removes PII within 30 days end-to-end; export produces a machine-readable archive within 7 days.

business_case: Build an AI-focused job portal that connects candidates with machine learning and data science roles. Strategic goals: (1) reduce manual recruiter effort by 60%, (2) onboard 500+ registered candidates in Q1, (3) GDPR-compliant candidate data handling end-to-end, and (4) full audit logging of every recruiter action for traceability.
